title: AppConfiguration
description: App-wide UI configuration. Seeded from yaml/env on first boot; DB-backed and admin-mutable at runtime afterwards (yaml is ignored once a DB row exists).

defaultAppMode.description: Tenant-wide 'first impression' app-mode default. Seeds the app mode for users who have not chosen one; user preference and persona-level app mode still win over this default. Null means no tenant default is configured.

defaultViewModes.description: Tenant-wide default view (list, grid, or tree) per page context that has a view toggle. Keys are page identifiers (dataProducts, domains, subDomains, learningResources); a page with no entry keeps its own hardcoded default (list/table). 'tree' is only meaningful for the domains page context, which is the only one whose toggle offers a Tree view.
